definitions: Relating to the earliest age or period; original or primeval.
Relating to, denoting, or preserving the character of an early stage in the evolutionary or historical development of something.
Having a quality or style that is simple or unsophisticated.
Relating to or denoting a human society or social stage with a very low level of industrial and technological development.
Relating to or denoting an animal or plant at a very early stage in its evolutionary development.
Relating to or denoting a belief, practice, or custom belonging to a preliterate, non-industrial society.
